opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 (in special cases up to £750,000; most grants below £300,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based organisations and researchers. Does not fund individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, unaffiliated individuals, schools/FE colleges, undergraduate or master's student-led projects, or projects led by non-UK-based organisations (exceptional overseas cases possible).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions (set out in its Strategic Review) and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications encouraged. Supports research on racial diversity within the UK.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year (Autumn).
